# vpsie_protect_policies (Data Source)

Lists the account's Backup and Protect policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_protect_policies" "active" {
  state = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `state` (String) Only policies in this state: `active`, `paused` or `pending_approval`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `policies` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `consistency` (String) `app` or `crash`.
- `datacenter` (String) The datacenter identifier.
- `identifier` (String) The policy identifier.
- `immutability_days` (Number) Days a recovery point cannot be deleted.
- `name` (String) The policy name.
- `rpo_minutes` (Number) The recovery point objective in minutes.
- `state` (String) The policy state.
- `tier` (String) `backup` or `dr`.
- `verify_mode` (String) `off`, `latest-daily` or `latest-weekly`.
- `version` (Number) The policy version.
